• Brand introduction:
Stayrai is a Kickstarter-backed startup based in Munich, Germany. Featured in the Financial Times, Stayrai manufactures the smartest solutions for sustainable home aquatics. We provide top-of-the-line automation tools and applications to conveniently care for aquatic environments, offering AI-driven intelligent solutions for optimal care and conditions. Our offerings include maintenance automation for ornamental fish, home fish farming, home-grow aquaponics, and much more.

• Product description:

Rein

Rein is the ultimate automation tool for your home aquarium. With its cutting-edge AI technology, Rein monitors water quality, temperature, and other vital parameters to ensure a thriving aquatic environment. It offers automated water changes, automatic top-off (ATO), and supports app notifications for real-time updates. Rein also includes smart power plugs and smart water pumps to enhance your aquarium's functionality. Additionally, Rein comes with two dosing pumps, programmable for dosing additives such as those needed for corals and heavily planted aquariums. Whether you have ornamental fish or are engaged in home fish farming, Rein guarantees optimal conditions for your aquatic life, providing a hands-free, stress-free experience for aquarium enthusiasts.

Lite

Lite is our compact and affordable solution for maintaining a healthy and vibrant home aquarium. Designed for ease of use, Lite offers essential features including automated water changes, automatic top-off (ATO), and app support with notifications. It also comes equipped with temperature sensors, smart power plugs, and smart water pumps, ensuring comprehensive care for your aquatic environment. Its user-friendly app allows you to manage your aquarium from anywhere, ensuring your fish receive the care they need even when you're not at home. Lite is perfect for beginners and hobbyists looking for reliable and efficient aquarium maintenance.

Aquaponic Grow Box

The Aquaponic Grow Box is a revolutionary product that combines fish farming with hydroponic plant growth. This self-sustaining system uses fish waste to fertilize plants, creating a harmonious environment where both thrive. Ideal for home-grow enthusiasts, the Aquaponic Grow Box provides a sustainable way to produce fresh vegetables and herbs while maintaining a healthy fish habitat. Its smart automation features ensure balanced water quality and nutrient levels, making it easy to achieve a flourishing aquaponic ecosystem.

 
• USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Complete and Advanced: The most comprehensive and advanced solution in the market.
  • Automated Maintenance: Effortless care with cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Energy Efficiency: Reduce energy costs by 50%.
  • Water Optimization: Reuse waste through advanced aquaponics filtration.
  • Real-Time App Support: Manage your aquarium from anywhere.
  • Sustainable Living: Eco-friendly solutions for a healthier environment.
